Quick reminder for customers
It is easier with this note
Traveling with pets is smoother when you check in a little early and keep your pet documents ready.

Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is here to help you and your pet get set for boarding with as little fuss as possible. Our welcome team checks the basics, answers routine questions, and makes sure each traveler knows what to expect before heading onward.

Please keep your pet calm, leashed, or safely secured, and bring any food, water, or comfort items that may help along the way. If your companion needs special care, let the desk know so we can guide you through the normal steps and keep things steady. We also ask travelers to use clean carriers and tidy gear, since that helps the whole area stay pleasant for everyone.

If you are arriving with a new travel routine, take a moment to speak with us before moving to the gate. We are happy to point out the right line, review the paperwork you have on hand, and support a smooth start for both you and your pet. Keep an eye on your belongings and stay close to the desk if you need a hand.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
